record.title: Execute one frozen private whole-sequence ADC control suite
record.intent: Falsify observer sequencing and thread coverage before admitting any new stock continuation.
requirements: Recheck stock preservation capacity and frozen source/binary/profile pins before one disposable guest suite. Install no stock application in this private control experiment.
Run only the frozen control set and independent verifiers. Preserve unexpected outcomes as conclusions without editing the run or adapting its model. Do not rerun merely to obtain a desired result.

Verify normal atomic progress then final precise stop, worker dependency completion, full thread convergence, modeled read/write counts and fail-closed divergence arms. Retain raw outputs indexes and status records.
Verify system_server stability enforcing policy final health and complete cleanup. Commit and push the conclusion before any successor experiment.
acceptance: The frozen suite has a reproducible positive or negative conclusion with health and cleanup evidence committed and pushed.
